reviewer_statement: Provisional developer-reviewed source scientific graph law, source-result metadata and validated postfit input domain. Direct frozen Python 1.2 typed SciPy CSR comparisons cover triangles, disconnected and zero-edge graphs with invalid-domain negative cases. Exact-head CI has not completed; no independent review is claimed.
native_language_semantic_policy: SciPy CSR and Python frozen dataclasses are represented by native Matrix sparse S3 scientific records, not Python object identities. The existing R API retains its default legacy output.

case_evidence.description: Postfit Python 1.2 nonlinear_types.RecurrenceResult auto-recurrence source record and canonical RecurrenceNetworkResult fields; native R source mode accepts the corresponding complete scientific list and returns the source-field ordered S3 record.

Seven-state dense and sparse symmetric binary recurrence graphs with declared time_a/time_b, Theiler=1, unweighted edges, irregular or repeated matched axes and optional null time unit; R Matrix sparse canonicalization preserves exact source edge geometry.

SciPy-compatible undirected degree, normalized degree, triangle counts, zero-degree clustering, connected components in ascending root order, transitivity with NaN no-triple convention, density and largest/isolated component fractions; direct typed frozen Python differential comparisons.
Source mode rejects cross-recurrence, mismatched time grids, negative Theiler, diagonal edges, within-Theiler edges, asymmetric adjacency, too few nodes and incomplete scientific records.

Exactly fifteen canonical source result fields with a source-shaped native sparse adjacency, complete retained RecurrenceResult scientific source record, original key names/values in source network provenance, source-ordered component IDs and compatible node/summary frame helpers.

Topology induced by the analyst-supplied auto-recurrence relation after declared threshold and Theiler filtering; no new radius selection, weighting, community analysis, resampling, model fitting or dimension inference.

independent_review_status: Author-reviewed source-pinned evidence only; frozen-Python exact-head CI and independent certification outstanding.
language_specific_limits: R Matrix sparse adjacency replaces SciPy CSR and the Python dataclass class identity, preserving source graph topology and result numerical arrays.
A 100,000-node native sparse-network resource guard remains; Python sparse graph allocation depends on host resources.
R validates complete scientific record values; exact arbitrary Python exception class and runtime object coercion are not native R semantics.
R legacy aliases remain in default mode; canonical Python result schema requires python_boundary_mode=TRUE.
